newsitem.title: GERMANY: Preussag boosted by year-end results.
newsitem.headline: Preussag boosted by year-end results.

text.p: Shares in German engineering group Preussag AG were lifted strongly on Thursday by better than expected results for 1995/1996 and hopes of a good outlook for the current year.
The stock was up 8.50 marks, or 2.2 percent, at 396.50 marks at 1005 GMT, outperforming the broader market where the 30-share DAX index was flat at 3,099.92 points.

Preussag earlier reported that its group net profit dropped to 274 million marks in 1995/1996, but said it would hold its dividend at 12 marks per share. The outlook for the current year was good, the company added.
"The past year's net figure was clearly better than expected. A lot of people had been worried that the company would cut its dividend to 10 marks," said a Frankfurt dealer.
